cards.title: Main Bearings and Connecting Rod Bearings
cards.body: We replace main bearings and connecting rod bearings as standard during a B48 rebuild.

cards.title: Complete Gasket and Seal Set
cards.body: We replace the full set of gaskets and seals as standard during a B48 rebuild.

cards.title: Timing Chain Components
cards.body: We inspect and replace timing chain components where required during a B48 rebuild. We inspect and measure the crankshaft, cylinder head, VANOS components, oil pump, cooling system, fuel injectors, high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP), turbocharger, and PCV system as standard. Application-Dependent Components Vehicle-specific ancillaries are accounted for once your exact model and generation are confirmed.
